basic_info.chief_complaint: The right back tooth has been crooked for several years.

chief_complaint.chief_complaint: The right back tooth has been crooked for several years.

present_illness.present_illness: The patient complained that when his wisdom teeth were extracted a few years ago, he found that the right back tooth was crooked. The doctor recommended correction. Now he comes for consultation. I felt discomfort in the right joint, with snapping sounds, and occasionally limited mouth opening.
present_illness.past_history: Have dental visit experience. He denies any history of systemic disease or drug allergy.

oral_examination.oral_examination: Full permanent dentition, slightly crowded and uneven, 17 buccal tilt, 47 lingual tilt, 17/47 positive locking.

treatment_plan.definitive: It is recommended that you first go to a jaw joint clinic to check whether there are joint abnormalities, and then consider orthodontic treatment to align the teeth, release locking, and adjust the bite relationship.

source_handle: Oral hygiene education, appointment with temporomandibular joint clinic.
